title: Agent Archivist inventory result (archivist.cli-result/v1)
description: The result document of the `inventory` command (plan Phase 5; CLI-015): one read-only pass that measures the complete outstanding bytes and events per discovered source against the acknowledged state and reports the bounded per-scope statuses and fleet totals — without uploading anything. Every figure is a content-free counter or a closed-vocabulary token; no field carries a path, a transcript body, a secret value or reference string, or an unbounded identifier (SEC-004, CFG-027).

x-archivist.compatibility: member additions are additive within v1 per plan Section 7.1 (CLI-015); redefining or removing a member, or a new namespace, is a v2 event

schema.description: The CLI result namespace. Present in every result document so a consumer always knows which contract it is reading before anything else (VAL-001); an unknown namespace is not this format and fails closed.

generated_at.description: The instant the inventory pass ran its lag arithmetic against (plan Section 7.3).

overall.description: The scopes' coverage states aggregated, and partial while any state-known source went unmeasured. Closed vocabulary shared with the adapter status layer; an unknown token is not this format.

sources_without_scan.description: State-known sources no adapter scan covered this pass. Their backlog is unmeasured, so the report counts them instead of guessing.

statuses.description: One bounded status per observed (adapter, account) scope, in first-seen scan order. The status layer never carries per-source detail: its size is independent of how many sources, sessions, or bytes an account holds.

totals.description: Fleet-level totals across every scope in the report.

adapter.description: The adapter whose pass observed the scope: a closed-vocabulary adapter identifier, never free text.

account.description: The configured account label the scope was discovered under: a routing name the operator picked, never an upstream account identifier value (the fleet inventory's sanitization contract).

coverage.description: The scope's coverage state: the member sources' states aggregated.

active_backlog_bytes.description: Outstanding bytes on freshness-lane sources in this scope.

active_backlog_events.description: Outstanding complete records on freshness-lane sources in this scope.

historical_backlog_bytes.description: Outstanding bytes on backfill-lane sources in this scope.

historical_backlog_events.description: Outstanding complete records on backfill-lane sources in this scope.

max_freshness_lag_seconds.description: The largest per-source freshness lag in the scope; zero when every source is caught up or no time basis exists.

coverage_sources.description: Per-state source counts across the scope.

classifications.description: How the scope's last scans ended, per closed classification.

coverage-counts.description: Per-state source counts, one counter per closed coverage token.

classification-counts.description: Last-scan classification counts, one counter per closed classification token.

active_backlog_bytes.description: Outstanding bytes on freshness-lane sources fleet-wide.

active_backlog_events.description: Outstanding complete records on freshness-lane sources fleet-wide.

historical_backlog_bytes.description: Outstanding bytes on backfill-lane sources fleet-wide.

historical_backlog_events.description: Outstanding complete records on backfill-lane sources fleet-wide.

sources.description: Per-state source counts across the scopes of the report.
